Sources & honest scope

What this is

  • A browser-side port of sovos_core.gspc.score_gspc() — the same scoring logic the sov CLI runs.
  • The 13 principles come from ETSI EN 304 223 (AI cybersecurity, published Jan 2026).
  • The 4 axes (G/S/P/C) are CSOAI's GSPC framework.
  • Composite score = geometric mean of the 4 axes (so any zero = zero).

What this is NOT

  • Not a certification. It's an instrument, not a stamp. We surface UNMEASURED, not a "pass/fail" judgement.
  • Not exhaustive. Real ETSI EN 304 223 compliance requires documentation review, audit trail inspection, and human-in-the-loop oversight. This tool checks 36 control flags against 13 principles — that's the surface, not the substance.
  • Not a substitute for the GSPC sovereign stack (csoai-governance-crosswalk-mcp, mcp-sov-signal, csoai-c2pa-signer). These verify the same principles against real audit evidence at scale.

For enterprise use
